notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/c4e371537b3aecdca5abd5dee2e06726759a3aa3.png[/img]

[b]🔷 Hello, dear friends![/b]

Despite the slight lull in our social media and the studio's busy schedule, we sincerely wish you a Happy New Year!

May 2025 be a year of fulfillment and fulfillment of your most cherished desires, and every day will be filled with joy and new opportunities. We wish you and your loved ones good health, love and warmth in your homes, and success in any endeavors. We hope that in the new year you will have more reasons to laugh, more adventures, cool ideas and exciting events!

Summing up the results of 2024, I would like to note that the year was extremely difficult, but our team is more determined and willing than ever to work on the game, constantly improve and refine it. In addition, let's not forget about the impressive results that we have achieved over these 12 months, and about the many positive moments that we were lucky enough to experience. First of all, this is, of course, the release of the first official Pigeon trailer, which has gathered a lot of positive feedback and comments from viewers, as well as visits to our studio at various major events dedicated to game development, a huge number of models and animations made, heroes and villains invented and written from scratch, new mechanics developed and tested, and much more-much more.

Next year we have prepared a lot of exciting and interesting things for you, which we don't want to talk about yet in order to leave the intrigue!) But we promise that the development of the game will move to a whole new level!

Many thanks to everyone who stays with us and follows the progress of our studio. We love and appreciate each of you very much! See you in 2025!!!) ❤

notes.title: Monster Veruca!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/90f7b40b5293f5292cccd7d15ed7f51220de1400.jpg[/img]

[b]🔷 Hello, dear friends![/b]

Today we want to introduce you to another monster of our game, but this time not an evil and dangerous monster ready to destroy the player at any moment, but a cute and harmless creature that is called Veruca in the world of birds!

Verucas are domesticated creatures, extremely inquisitive, interested in everything, but at the same time timid. They can usually be found in pens, but due to their small size and innate curiosity, they often escape. But to catch at least one of them is already a task with an asterisk, since they run very fast. Veruca is an analogue of a chicken from the real world, and although they do not look like each other outwardly, they are bred for one purpose: meat and a footnote of eggs that come out through their backs, where there are special holes for this.

Like many other monsters from our game, the Verucas will have several colors, and you can enjoy the beautiful view of this chubby creature on the attached art!)

notes.title: Work on the NPC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/801622dae3add8bfead137ba48ce6e124c401676.jpg[/img]

[b]🔷 Hello, dear friends![/b]

As you know, there will be many different characters in our game, both important, plot-based, and ordinary NPCs who walk around the world and go about their daily business. Since Pigeon's budget is limited, we cannot afford to create unique models for ordinary villagers as well. However, this does not mean that we have given up and that now all NPCs in the game will be the same. So what did we do? Let's consider our solution using the example of the blacksmith Volt.

Despite the fact that the non-player characters have one model, we tried to make each of them as different from each other as possible. Firstly, we create our own unique distinctive color for each bird, and we do it not at random, but taking as a basis the species of birds existing in real life with interesting and unusual colors! Secondly, clothing is also undergoing changes, and not only the color, but also some details and drawings. For example, one character's T-shirt may have something painted on it, and another's T-shirt may have a patch on it. All this helps to make the world around you in the game less monotonous and more lively!

notes.title: The character Harry!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/a3e757f7faedca9e4e946b4df81ca66bcc9147bf.jpg[/img]

[b]🔷 Hello, dear friends![/b]

Today we want to introduce you to another interesting and funny character of our game, as well as show you his ready-made high-poly model! Meet Harry the jackdaw named Pig Iron!

One night, a visiting woman, whom no one knew, left a wicker basket with a baby jackdaw inside in front of the entrance to the temple. After leaving the baby alone, she almost immediately left the island and was never heard from again. But the baby was lucky: 17-year-old Michel, who had just lost his parents due to an accident, really wanted to shelter him. Everyone around doubted that the boy would be able to bear such a burden of responsibility. However, the Cockle priest vouched for the young man, but with one condition: he would not reject help in raising the baby bird, who was later named Harry.

Despite the fact that Michel loved his pupil very much, he was completely unable to show emotions, which made Harry feel lonely. Plus, the jackdaw didn't have any friends at all, since there were no peers left in the neighborhood, and the older guys didn't want to play with him. Therefore, most of the time Harry entertained himself, walking in the woods and climbing in an abandoned village.

Nevertheless, the lack of attention from his foster father worried him very much, and in order to achieve at least some emotions, Harry began to mess up, take other people's things and spoil property, but in response he received only unbearably boring readings of verses from the scriptures. He did not understand that it was possible to attract attention to himself through work and help from others, until one day Urus, who should not run himself, began to send Harry something to carry, then to convey some information. And galchonok was only happy that he could communicate with his elders at least in this way. It was Urus who told Harry that if it weren't for the gray feathers, then he could be called Pig Iron, and Harry liked this nickname so much that he began to demand that everyone call him that!

Now it never occurred to him to take someone else's, because every now and then he was either given a coin or treated to something by grateful customers.

notes.title: Pogg's finished character model!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/a002dc987c833622817ff8cf793c8daa6974be1d.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, dear friends![/b]

More recently, we talked and showed the concept art of such a character in our game as Pogg, and today we are ready to share with you a fully finished model of this daring and treacherous sparrow!

As a reminder, Pogg is very similar to Urus in his personality traits and behaviour. But while Urus used manipulation, lies and persuasion to achieve his goals, Pogg, on the other hand, always went straight ahead and used the right of the strong. Of course, the villagers tried their best to stop the young sparrow's attempts at banditry, but, alas, they were not always successful. Nevertheless, Pogg realised that it would be more and more difficult to continue to carry out his deeds alone, so he needed a gang of his own. One thing Pogg hadn't taken into account was that he couldn't count on honest and loyal friendship among scumbag kids like himself. For the power the others gave him over them, they got nothing in return. Sparrow took all the laurels and honours for himself, leaving not a penny for his team, and in time it became clear that there were no prospects in this gang. But, unfortunately, it was too late to leave, for all of them had acquired a bad reputation in the village, they were neither accepted nor respected, and it was impossible to go anywhere but to Pogg's gang.

Every year Pogg grew greedier and greedier. One day Varya, the sister of Richard and Urus, caught his eye. Looking at her as an object of possession, Pogg wanted to take her for himself and began to devise a plan to capture the dove. From that moment on, a very uneasy relationship began between Varya's family and Pogg.

notes.title: The Plant system!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/00d4389b474302611c66343f75a10acc1f3a89dc.png[/img]

[b]Hello, dear friends![/b]

Last week we told you about such an interesting mechanic as Plant, and exactly how it will be implemented in the game itself. Today we want to delve into the technical part of this system and talk about how it all works in practice.

[b]📌 Part 2.[/b]

The Plant system is designed to solve 2 main tasks:

1. Creating zones for the appearance and disappearance of many monsters at specified points.
2. Changing the behavioral characteristics of Plants.

Let's talk about each item separately.

1. The feature of this system is the activation of habitat zones and the nth number of points of appearance of creatures in it. When the player's character crosses the border of the zone, the spawn points are activated in it, which in turn create in their place related Plant instances. In addition, the zones themselves may overlap with each other. That is, when one of the zones is activated, Plants appear not only in the corresponding zone, but also at the point of contact. At the same time, each zone will use the contact zone as its own. At the moment when a player leaves one of the intersecting zones and moves to another without leaving both at once, the Plants in the area of contact do not disappear. In the rest of the area, the zones that have just been touched appear, and in the zone that has just been left they disappear.

2. The behavior of the Plants depends on which zone the player is in at the moment. There are 4 such zones in total.

- Neutral. Plant does not react to the player in any way.
- Preparation. The Plant begins to feel the player, move and reach out its tentacles.
- Attacking with medium damage. The Plant attacks in a circle in the range.
- Attacking with maximum damage. When the player is directly under the Plant, he attacks it straight down with all his strength.

In addition, our team does not forget about optimization. We try to correctly place habitat zones, do not load the system with unnecessary areas, and also monitor the balance of difficulty and the number of enemies on the level so that you feel comfortable and interesting playing our game!)

notes.title: The Plant system!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/4f9c2f1ed4bafd24bc6af645da6299a9283a6987.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, dear friends![/b]

Today we want to tell you about a rather complicated, but interesting and ready-made mechanic called Plant. Since this system is quite multifaceted, we will divide this news into two parts and now tell you how it works directly during the game.

📌 Part 1.

A Plant is a predatory plant creature that lives in dungeons and is located on the vaults and walls of caves. Hunting various creatures, he lures them to him with his mana-filled tentacles. The tentacles themselves are extremely toxic, and upon contact with them, the victim will be affected by hallucinogenic substances.

From the gameplay point of view of the mechanic, we work as follows: when a player approaches a Plant, he will feel it and begin to react to it, pulling out his tentacles and luring the victim to himself. Since the Plant does not have eyes and is oriented in space only thanks to its appendages, it will not attack immediately, but will wait until the player gets close enough, and then it will begin to attack. Moreover, while the player is standing next to him, he will hit the entire circle, causing average damage to the character. But if you go up and stand under it, the Plant will strike straight down, causing maximum damage. The player, in turn, will have the opportunity to block his blows and counterattack, and in case of a successful attack, the monster will abruptly hide its tentacles and cover itself with leaves, creating armor through which damage will not pass through it. To finally kill Plant, you will have to wait until he opens up again, and then deal him a fatal blow.

It is worth noting that Plant's behavior extends not only to the player, but also to everyone else, including monsters. So in some situations, this feature can be used to your advantage!)

notes.title: The character Pogg!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/5f3fcd3bd56d64553517ddcebc94a1c15175079c.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, dear friends![/b]

Today we will introduce you to another interesting character from our game - a cheeky and dangerous sparrow named Pogg!

Pogg is very similar to Urus in his character traits and behaviour. But while Urus used manipulation, lies and persuasion to achieve his goals, Pogg, on the other hand, always went straight ahead and used the right of the strong. Of course, the villagers tried their best to stop the young sparrow's attempts at banditry, but, alas, they were not always successful. Nevertheless, Pogg realised that it would be more and more difficult to continue to carry out his deeds alone, so he needed a gang of his own. One thing Pogg hadn't taken into account was that he couldn't count on honest and loyal friendship among scumbag kids like himself. For the power the others gave him over them, they got nothing in return. Sparrow took all the laurels and honours for himself, leaving not a penny for his team, and in time it became clear that there were no prospects in this gang. But, unfortunately, it was too late to leave, for all of them had acquired a bad reputation in the village, they were neither accepted nor respected, and it was impossible to go anywhere but to Pogg's gang.

Every year Pogg grew greedier and greedier. One day Varya, the sister of Richard and Urus, caught his eye. Looking at her as an object of possession, Pogg wanted to take her for himself and began to devise a plan to capture the dove. From that moment on, a very uneasy relationship began between Varya's family and Pogg.

notes.title: Character Design!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/1f7c06455839f6760ee567ff134ac3cda4776455.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, dear friends![/b]

A few days ago, someone wrote to us in private messages with an interesting question about how exactly we create and come up with character designs for our game. Well, there are really a lot of bright birds in Pigeon, so now we will try to answer this question and tell you everything in detail!

To begin with, it is worth noting that one of the key goals of our team is to show in the game as many different bird species as possible that exist in real life. To do this, the narrative design department first studied a huge number of birds, noting the peculiarities of the behavior of each of them, then chose the most interesting, familiar and rare species, and after that they were directly engaged in creating characters: prescribed their image, character, background, etc.

When the character is ready, artists step in and give him an original and memorable appearance. Of course, the appearance of the hero is not drawn "from nonsense". The artists take a real bird as a basis and take into account all the subtleties of a particular species, such as body structure, such as beak, tail, paws and other things, as well as color, after which they add some unique elements to the character's design, such as hairstyle, jewelry and, of course, clothes. As for the latter, here artists also study various references and historical photographs in order to achieve maximum authenticity, plausibility and emphasize one or another character trait of a character, or his belonging to something. All this helps to achieve recognition for the important and central characters of the game.

notes.title: High-poly Insago character model!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/d3c6f170e1de3fa89a7cd9a937911f2d2f90e3a2.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, dear friends![/b]

We are pleased to present you the finished high-poly model of the Insago duck!

Even as a young man, Insago was not particularly popular among other children and never flaunted his achievements, and his academic success seemed average, as a result of which he established himself as a fairly quiet and modest bird. He was raised by a single mother who loved him madly and surrounded her son with care and attention in every possible way, from which he was very afraid to disappoint her on any occasion and always tried to make her proud of him.

One day, the head of the village came to their house and asked for help: the woodcutter Woodpecker was forced to leave the village for several days, and he needed to be replaced urgently. Of course, to please his mother and earn some money, as well as out of respect for the head, Insago agreed to this job. The first days were very difficult, as he had to figure out all the subtleties of this difficult craft himself, but surprisingly, he did an excellent job.

When the term of his temporary replacement at the sawmill came to an end, the head of the village again asked him to become a new permanent lumberjack, since the Woodpecker, for unknown reasons, had long stopped contacting him, and then disappeared altogether. Insago didn't like this job, but he couldn't give it up, because he didn't want to upset his mother, who was very proud of him.

In the end, Insago reluctantly agreed. This job made him depressed, and even despite the gratitude of many villagers, he still considered himself a loser.

Richard understood that few people were interested in him in his native village, that he had no prospects here, but still, deep down, he hoped and believed that outside of it he would be able to somehow prove himself and find his place in the sun.

notes.title: Comparing a character in childhood and now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033694/3dcbc1032bd762602e2bf6e2f45085be968c04e7.jpg[/img]

[b]🔷 Hello, dear friends![/b]

As you know, the premiere of the first official trailer of our game took place last week! It featured several different locations, monsters and characters, as well as an intriguing scene at the end in which Ron the eagle reads a book to his children Richard, Urus and Varya. We decided to show a more detailed comparison of the two versions of each of the members of this large family, and today we will show you two models of the hummingbird Urus: an adult and a child!)

And the comparison of other characters in childhood and now we will show next time!)

[b]Urus [/b]is a vain hummingbird who is a half—brother to Richard and Varya. All three grew up in the same house under the supervision of Eagle's foster father Ron, and the living conditions were equally difficult for all. Although the villagers occasionally helped them with food and money, and tried to educate the children as much as possible, all this help can only be called "cosmetic", insignificant. Poverty, poverty and hunger haunted their entire childhood, however, if Richard learned to take care of himself and his loved ones himself and did not cross the line with requests, then Urus, on the contrary, being born with certain narcissistic tendencies, constantly asked for more than he needed. And it's hard to call it begging, because, as he believed, the ability to present information in such a way that in the end they themselves wanted to help you is priceless. Urus is convinced that money and other material goods are not so important if you can manipulate others and express your thoughts in such a way as to convince everyone that you are right. It was thanks to his character and talent that he was able to make friends with many children, and later make them his fans. Although some villagers saw through Urus and did not succumb to his "charms", but, to tell the truth, there were very few of them. One of them, of course, is Richard. But Varya is the opposite.
